notes.parsing_notes: Modeled IV rituximab and SC rituximab/hyaluronidase as separate request routes. Applied CD20-positive requirement to oncologic clusters and Hycela route. Implemented RA biomarker and MTX pathway as stated. Applied glucocorticoid co-therapy guard to ANCA-associated vasculitides and pauci-immune GN based on policy notes. Added cluster-entry exclusions for concomitant biologics/DMTs for RA, MS, and NMOSD. Created terminal routes for listed non-covered CPT/lab services.
